_design_note: M3.8. The sole change from M3.3LX is the hidden layer widths, (64, 32) -> (128, 64) (route R02_3 -> R02_5; the two routes differ in that one field). mean_hidden_zero_fraction was 0.625 at the end of the 2000-round arm and 0.745 at the end of the 5000-round one (docs/01 sections 7.12.4 and 7.18), so three quarters of the units are silent on a typical input and the trend is toward fewer, not more. Whether that is a capacity limit or healthy sparsity is exactly what this arm measures.
